offering_description.value: Owns and operates a San Francisco hotel and owns apartment complexes, earning money from hotel stays and apartment rents, and also invests in marketable securities. Hotel guests and apartment tenants pay directly for rooms, services and leases.

primary_services.value: hotel accommodation; food and beverage; parking; apartment property management

customer_segment.value: B2C: hotel guests and apartment tenants; B2B: corporate and group hotel bookings

end_markets.value: hospitality and travel; residential rental housing; securities investment

revenue_model.value: service fees: hotel room, food and beverage, and parking charges; rental or leasing: apartment rent from residential tenants; other: investment gains and income from marketable securities
revenue_model.category: service fees; rental or leasing; other

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates hotel and sells rooms and services to guests; asset operator: owns and runs hotel and apartment properties, leasing space to tenants

geography_served.value: US national: hotel in San Francisco, California, apartments in Texas, Missouri and other states

specialization.value: diversified: hotel operations, apartment rental properties, marketable securities investments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: apartment leasing to individual tenants and direct hotel bookings; online: hotel bookings through websites and online travel platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hotel licensing, fire and health codes, and local rental housing and tenant rules

notes: Property locations, holdings and business mix may have changed; details are based on general knowledge and should be checked.
